description: The plot illustrates the loss over training time for two different models, Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis represents training time in seconds, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250000, and tick labels at intervals of 50000. The y-axis represents loss, also with a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, and tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The plot shows two lines: a purple line with circle markers and a solid style representing Vanilla, and a red line with circle markers and a solid style representing SepLLM. Both lines start at a high loss value around 2.75-2.78 and decrease as training time increases, with the Vanilla line starting at approximately 2.78 and decreasing to around 2.62 at 250000 seconds, and the SepLLM line starting at approximately 2.74 and decreasing to around 2.60 at 250000 seconds; both lines exhibit a sharp decline initially, followed by a gradual decrease, with the SepLLM line consistently below the Vanilla line throughout the training time.
